title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
STUART BANNER
NORMAN ABRAMS DISTINGUISHED PROFESSOR OF LAW
SCHOOL OF LAW
BOX 951476
LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA 90095-1476
Phone: (310) 206-8506
Email: banner@law.ucla.edu

April 8, 2025


Hon. Scott S. Harris
Clerk, Supreme Court of the United States
One First St., NE
Washington, DC 20543

 Re: Villarreal v. Texas, No. 24-557

Dear Mr. Harris:

 I am counsel of record for petitioner David Villarreal in the above -captioned case, in which the
Court granted certiorari on April 7, 2025.

 Because of the press of other business , the parties join tly request , pursuant to Rule 30.4,
extensions of time according to the following briefing schedule:

 Brief for Petitioner: June 3, 2025
 Brief for Respondent: July 15, 2025
 Reply Brief: August 26, 2025

 Thank you for your consideration of this request.


Sincerely,

Stuart Banner
Counsel for petitioner
cc: Andrew N. Warthen, counsel for respondent
